summary.text: Stephanie Borowicz is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 76, which she has represented since December 2018, and she is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
Ballotpedia describes her as the first woman to represent the district.

paragraphs.text: Borowicz graduated from Altamonte Christian School in 1995 and earned a bachelor's degree in liberal studies with a minor in Bible studies from Vanguard University in 1999.
Before her election to the Pennsylvania House she was a stay-at-home mother, and she previously worked as a fourth-grade teacher and as president of a nonprofit organization.
Ballotpedia reports that she and her husband have three sons.
In the 2023-2024 session Borowicz was assigned to the House Agriculture & Rural Affairs, Environmental Resources & Energy, and Health committees.
